map.静息能量 RER = 70 × 10^0.75 ≈ 393.6 kcal；每日需: Resting energy RER = 70 × 10^0.75 ≈ 393.6 kcal; daily requirement DER = 393.6 × 1.6 (normal · intact) = 629.8 kcal. Total treat calories = 15 × 5 = 75 kcal, which is 11.9% of the daily total and already over the 10% safety cap (≈63 kcal). Reduce to at most 4 treats a day, or switch to small 2–5 kcal training treats. For comparison, a 4 kg cat with 5 kcal per treat × 3 treats accounts for only 6.94%, still within the safe range.
map.为什么狗狗和猫咪的算法不一样？: Why do dogs and cats use different formulas?
map.犬用 Kleiber 幂律 RER=70×体重^0.75（更适合跨体型缩放），猫: Dogs use the Kleiber power law RER = 70 × body weight^0.75 (better for scaling across body sizes), while cats use the linear RER = 40 × body weight + 20 (an empirical formula for small felids); both then multiply by activity, neuter and age factors to get DER. Mixing the formulas systematically overestimates or underestimates calories.
map.零食超标了一定要减颗数吗？: Do you always have to cut the number of treats when over the limit?
map.优先减颗数或换低热量零食；若已超标较多（>20%），还应相应扣减主粮份量（本例需: Prefer cutting the number of treats or switching to lower-calorie treats; if the excess is large (>20%), also reduce the main meal portion accordingly (in this example about 12 kcal should come out of the main food). The general veterinary rule is that treat calories should not exceed 10% of total daily calories.
